# cksum

Compute and verify checksums through MoonX.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/cksum input.bin

moonx cli/cksum -a sha256 input.bin

moonx cli/cksum -a sha256 --untagged input.bin > checksums.txt
moonx cli/cksum -a sha256 -c checksums.txt
```

Default output contains the POSIX CRC checksum, byte count and optional filename. Modern digest algorithms also support checksum manifests.

## Common options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->
<!-- Generated by tools/metadata from options.json. -->

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-a VALUE`, `--algorithm VALUE` | Select the checksum algorithm listed above. |
| `-l VALUE`, `--length VALUE` | SHA2/SHA3: 224, 256, 384, 512; BLAKE2b: 8..512 by 8 |
| `--untagged` | omit algorithm tags (modern digests default to tags) |
| `-c`, `--check` | read checksum records and verify files |
| `--quiet` | suppress successful verification output |
| `--status` | suppress verification results and summaries |
| `--help` | Show help. |
| `--version` | Show the version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

Use `--help` for the complete option list.

## Notes

Workspace builds use the MoonBit 2026-11-26 toolchain.

- Supported algorithms include bsd, sysv, crc, crc32b, md5, sha1, sha224, sha256, sha384, sha512, sha2, sha3, blake2b and sm3.
- Legacy checksum algorithms do not support manifest checking. Raw output requires one input. Binary/text flags select manifest markers without translating file bytes.
- --ignore-missing still requires at least one successfully checked file.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
